concepts.title: ACTIVATION PROCEDURE
concepts.description: Step-by-step procedure to activate and configure EPS Fallback for IMS Voice.

concepts.title: DEACTIVATION PROCEDURE
concepts.description: Step-by-step procedure to deactivate the EPS Fallback for IMS Voice feature and disable the per-cell policy.

concepts.title: Feature Dependencies
concepts.description: Outlines the feature, hardware, network dependencies, and limitations for EPS Fallback for IMS Voice.

concepts.title: Feature Operation
concepts.description: Describes the per-cell and per-call decision logic, measurement configuration, and execution methods for EPS Fallback.

concepts.title: Feature Overview
concepts.description: EPS Fallback for IMS Voice enables voice service for UEs camped on NR Standalone (SA) by moving them to LTE at voice-call establishment.

concepts.title: Network Impact
concepts.description: Analyzes the impact of EPS Fallback on voice services, call setup delay, NR KPIs, LTE layer capacity, and signaling load.

concepts.title: Parameters
concepts.description: Configuration parameters per NR cell for EPS Fallback for IMS Voice, including fallback modes, methods, and measurement thresholds.

concepts.title: Performance Management
concepts.description: Performance management guidelines, KPIs, and counters for monitoring EPS Fallback for IMS Voice.
